# Decision-layer evaluation set (docs/DECISION-LAYER.md). Every utterance was invented for
# this file; none comes from a robot or a person. Format: expected command | utterance.
# scripts/decision-layer-eval.mjs holds out every third utterance of each label; tune only
# against the dev split, and run the held-out split once per change.
